title: Tunneler
move_pattern: Opens with Bite. Then cycles: Burrow → Attack from Below (repeats). When stunned, transitions to Still Dizzy to clear the stun and return to the start of the cycle.
notes: Tunneler gains the Burrowed power during Burrow, which provides Block and changes the monster's appearance and animations. Still Dizzy is a hidden move (not shown in bestiary) triggered when the monster is stunned; it clears the stun status and plays a wake-up animation. Attack from Below is performed from a hidden state with special visual positioning effects.
